info.name: Retrieves the status of the hotpluggable memory

items.docs: Reuturn the status of the hotpluggable memory. This can be used to follow the progress of the guest after a PATCH API.
Configure the hotpluggable memory, which is a virtio-mem device, with an associated memory area that can be hot(un)plugged in the guest on demand using the PATCH API.

info.name: Updates the size of the hotpluggable memory region

items.docs: Updates the size of the hotpluggable memory region. The guest will plug and unplug memory to hit the requested memory.
